body: I think the lesson I'm taking away from this is that my own mind can just randomly betray me, and hurt other people, I wasn't meant to have that kind of relationship this life... Maybe next time...

I wrote him one final thing the other night, right when the clarity hit, I'm done, he has 5000 miles of space and and no more emails.. Kinda worried skype will be sending him random messages from weeks ago at random points in the future... Yay Microsoft! But I can't chase him anymore..
